title: Part. The moment is now. Where then?
html_source:
In one sense, this is a simple moment. Stephen and Mulligan part to allow Bloom to pass between them.

Perhaps Stephen is contemplating parting from Mulligan’s company now that they are leaving the library.

However, if the chapter evokes the portion of the Odyssey where Odysseus must past between two dangers, does this mean Bloom is Odysseus and Stephen and Mulligan have become the dangers?

Is this some kind of mysterious transfer effected by Joyce from Stephen to Bloom?

 — The most innocent son of Erin, Stephen said, for whom they ever lifted them. 

 About to pass through the doorway, feeling one behind, he stood aside.

If Socrates leave his house today, if Judas go forth tonight. Why? That lies in space which I in time must come to, ineluctably. 

 My will: his will that fronts me. Seas between.
